title: Proper compatibility for relative-product factors
statement: Fix the data of the coefficient-factor theorem, compactifications cg and ch, and proper-coordinate structures J and J'. For every pair J,J', the proper projection and exchange normalizations and the coefficient comparison normalization hold, and the six proper-normalized factor squares satisfy A.ProperFactorSquares J J' cg ch.

source.place: Insert the specified proper identifications recursively at every support occurrence. Naturality identifies the conjugated projection and exchange maps with the direct-image normalization, while the proper identity coefficient square gives ProperComparisonNormalization. Conjugating the six coefficient squares by the recursively inserted identifications and cancelling inverse pairs gives ProperFactorSquares.
